glance: Chip stocks crater at the close: the Philadelphia semiconductor index falls about 7.9% and Nvidia gives back roughly 6% of Monday's record surge.
The Dow still finishes above 50,000, up about 423 points, as money rotates into retailers like Kohl's and Abercrombie.
Anthropic shares dip below their $83 IPO price four sessions after debuting.
Amazon buys Decart's AI-optimization technology for a reported $7.5 billion to boost its Trainium chips.
Traders now see near-certain odds of a Fed rate hike; Iran vows to resist the US naval blockade.

tech.headline: Chip stocks erase much of Monday's historic rally
tech.summary: All 30 stocks in the Philadelphia semiconductor index closed lower, with the index down nearly 8%. Nvidia fell about 6% and AMD and Micron dropped sharply a day after Jensen Huang's reinstatement as CEO sent Nvidia up more than 30%. The swing shows how jittery investors remain about how much AI growth is already priced in.

tech.headline: Anthropic stock slips below its IPO price
tech.summary: Shares of Anthropic briefly fell to about $82.30, under the $83 offering price, in only its fourth day of trading. Analysts pointed to the company's heavy capital needs, possible insider selling and profit-taking. A broken IPO this fast is an early test of public-market appetite for AI labs.

tech.headline: Amazon buys Decart's AI optimization tech for $7.5 billion
tech.summary: Amazon is acquiring Decart's technology and research team in a deal reported at $7.5 billion. The goal is to run AI models more efficiently on Amazon's in-house Trainium chips as it prepares to sell them more widely, adding pressure on Nvidia's dominance.

tech.headline: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $43.9 billion all-stock deal
tech.summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire fellow security firm Zscaler, combining endpoint protection with cloud network security. It would be one of the largest cybersecurity deals ever and will face regulatory review.

tech.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI claim AI-written proof of a 1979 conjecture
tech.summary: Both companies published proofs, generated largely by their AI models, that they say settle a long-open problem in complexity theory. Mathematicians have not yet verified either one, but a confirmed result would be a milestone for AI in research math.

tech.headline: US blacklists Megaspeed; Senate hearing on chip exports set
tech.summary: The Commerce Department added Singapore-based Megaspeed to its entity list over the risk of Nvidia chips being diverted to China. Senate Banking Chairman Tim Scott said a hearing on chip export controls is planned for December 3.

tech.headline: Google's AI Mode can now read your Drive and Wallet
tech.summary: Google Search's AI Mode gained optional connections to Google Drive and Google Wallet for more personalized answers, with Wallet access read-only. Separately, OpenAI widened its GPT-6.2 Sol model to paid ChatGPT plans.

markets.asOf: market close, Nov 24 (Nasdaq, yield, oil and bitcoin as of ~2:30 PM CT)
markets.summary: A chip-stock rout dragged the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower while the Dow closed above 50,000 on gains in retail and other non-tech names.

movers.name: Nvidia
movers.note: Gives back part of Monday's 31% Huang-return surge

movers.name: AMD
movers.note: Caught in broad semiconductor selloff (late session)

movers.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
movers.note: Guided AI unit margins lower for fiscal 2027

movers.name: Dollar Tree
movers.note: Beat estimates and raised full-year guidance

other.headline: Traders bet heavily on a Fed rate hike
other.summary: Futures now price roughly a 95% chance of a quarter-point increase, and bets on at least two more hikes returned after strong data, including a better-than-expected consumer confidence reading.

other.headline: Iran vows to use all tools against US naval blockade
other.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry called the reinstated US blockade military aggression and said it would respond with every available means, though oil markets also watched signs of continuing diplomacy.

other.headline: Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia kills two
other.summary: An overnight attack hit an apartment building in the Ukrainian city, killing two and wounding dozens, including children, according to the regional governor.

other.headline: Appeals court revives Trump bid to move NY case to federal court
other.summary: A federal appeals panel ruled a judge erred in refusing to move Trump's 2024 New York felony case to federal court and sent it back for a prompt new ruling.

other.headline: UK sanctions Myanmar generals after ICJ genocide ruling
other.summary: Britain sanctioned five senior Myanmar military leaders after the International Court of Justice found Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya.

other.headline: About 81 million Americans expected to travel for Thanksgiving
other.summary: Forecasters expect near-record holiday travel this week, though slightly fewer drivers and flyers than last year.
